spans.s:
f. (-नी)
A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु.
E.
गो the earth, and वन्दनी praising.

m. (-नः)
A celebrated hill in Vindrāvan or the country about Mathura; it was upheld by KṚṢṆA upon one finger, to shelter the cowherds from a storm excited by INDRA, as a test of the former's divinity.
E.
गो a cow, and वर्द्धन encreasing; pasturing cattle.

m. (-धः)
A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU.
E.
गोवर्द्धन Govardhana, and धर who upholds: see the preceding.

f. (-शा)
A barren cow.
E.
गो a cow, and वशा barren.

m. (-न्दः)
1 One of the most usual appellations of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU in that form.
2 A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of

A cowkeeper, one who protects, cherishes or owns cattle.
E.
गो language, here the language of the Vedas especially, and विन्द who knows, from विद to know, with श affix; also गो heaven, a cow, विद to obtain, by whom heaven is obtained, or who obtains felicity by protecting kine.

f. (-विद्)
Cowdung.
E.
गो a cow, and विष् ordure; also गोविष्ठा.

n. (-न्दं)
1 Property in cattle, possession of flocks and herds.
2 A herd, a drove of cattle.
E.
गो a cow, and वृन्द a heap, a multitude.

m. (-कः)
A capital cow.
E.
गो a cow, and वृन्दारक affix of pre-eminence.

m. (-षः)
A bull.
E.
गो a cow, and वृष best, pre-eminent.

m. (-जः)
A station for cattle.
E.
गो and व्रज a pen, a fold.
